## Contract requirement

Ingest Avalanche-provided historical data (validator/delegator flows, rewards, durations)

## Evidence status

56 of 59 declared datasets have a built run. Each resolves to a source contract in `data/data-catalog.json`, an immutable capture receipt, a typed Parquet build, and a persisted check result. Delivered for the Avalanche team's review. Not yet accepted.

### Known gaps

- `snowflake.primary-validator-stakes`: rows without potential reward: 1; rows without reward status: 602; rows without staked utxo: 2
- `snowflake.primary-delegator-stakes`: rows with several delegator addresses: 8335; rows without delegator address: 75; rows without reward status: 33866; rows without staked utxo: 75
- `snowflake.primary-staking-rewards`: rows rewarded without reward utxo: 954; rows without reward utxo: 68016
- `snowflake.primary-staking-supply`: genesis rows: 75; rows in blocks where supply change differs from staking deltas: 2676285; rows in blocks where supply falls beyond removals: 199; rows without block supply: 75
- `snowflake.c-chain-evm-burn-daily`: 1 rows do not connect to adjacent C block days; 25 rows have absent C blocks, to read from the Data API block record
- `snowflake.primary-burn-daily`: 2 rows carry unresolved burns to settle from the Data API transaction record
- `coingecko.avax-market-daily`: partial day rows: 1; rows without volatility: 30
- `defillama.avax-price-daily`: dates with two observations: 343; rows without volatility: 30; skipped dates: 346
- `p-chain-rpc.reward-utxos`: rows without reward utxo: 184
- `data-api.c-chain-block-list`: no built run
- `defillama.pool-yields`: pools flagged outlier: 57
- `metrics-api.primary-staking-daily`: 9 rows follow a gap of more than one day; 823 of 2058 days differ from the Snowflake validator count by more than 2%; 437 of 2058 days differ from the Snowflake validator weight by more than 2%; 1571 of 2058 days differ from the Snowflake delegator count by more than 2%; 1269 of 2058 days differ from the Snowflake delegator weight by more than 2%; skipped dates: 9
- `metrics-api.c-chain-activity-daily`: 3 rows lack one of the series before the last complete day; days with a missing series: 6
- `data-api.validators-completed`: reward differs from the Snowflake capture on 1 validations
- `derived.avax-monetary-daily`: Data API rewards at 2026-09-19T11:00:18.236000 differs from the ledger by 2,527,926.793 AVAX beyond the 1.0 AVAX allowance; Data API total_supply at 2026-09-19T11:00:18.236000 differs from the ledger by 2,531,690.670 AVAX beyond the 1.0 AVAX allowance
- `derived.p-chain-validator-stakes`: the overlap with the share differs: 2 rows differ, 0 are missing here, 0 are missing in the share
- `derived.p-chain-delegator-stakes`: the overlap with the share differs: 75 rows differ, 0 are missing here, 0 are missing in the share
- `derived.p-chain-staking-rewards`: the overlap with the share differs: 10215 rows differ, 0 are missing here, 0 are missing in the share
- `derived.p-chain-staking-supply`: the overlap with the share differs: 75 rows differ, 0 are missing here, 0 are missing in the share
- `derived.c-chain-evm-burn-daily`: no built run
- `derived.primary-burn-daily`: 2 dates and chains differ from the share: 2026-09-22 P, 2026-09-22 X
- `derived.seamed-c-chain-evm-burn-daily`: no built run

Captures are working data and are not committed; the `data/README.md` guide reproduces them.
